faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for CMO Ballia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 27 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CMO Ballia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 14 vacancies: 2 Medical Officer (NCD Clinic CHC), 1 Female Medical Officer (FRU - Maternal Health Programme), 6 Medical Officer (EMO) (District Hospital Strengthening), 1 Medical Officer (NUHM - UPHC), 1 Medical Officer (NUHM - 15th Finance Commission), 2 Medical Officer (NUHM) and 1 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CMO Ballia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years (as on date of publication of the advertisement).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.100000 for Medical Officer (NCD Clinic CHC), Rs.100000 for Female Medical Officer (FRU - Maternal Health Programme), Rs-100000 for Medical Officer (EMO) (District Hospital Strengthening), Rs.80000 +20000 PBI for Medical Officer (NUHM - UPHC), Rs.80000 +20000 PBI for Medical Officer (NUHM - 15th Finance Commission).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS. Registration with the Uttar Pradesh Medical Council is mandatory. Medical Officer (EMO): one year of experience in the Emergency Ward of a 100-bedded hospital. Medical Officer (NCD): two years of experience. For the other posts, experience is preferred. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Registration with the Uttar Pradesh Medical Council is mandatory.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates older than 65 years on the date of publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Selection will follow the reservation policy in force of the Uttar Pradesh Government.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Posts are on contract at a fixed honorarium; no claim to permanence will be accepted. Appointment valid for up to one financial year; may be extended after approval of the Government of India. Contract/service may be ended on any adverse fact with one month's notice or one month's amount in lieu of notice.
